call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished independent flat fictional product launch poster, portrait aspect ratio exactly 4:5, with the photograph and typography in the same continuous scene. This is an original photographic carry composition, not a catalog layout, mockup, multi-panel image, or packaging.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Primary idea: the compact collapsed cup is ready to be put into a bag. Show one human hand clearly holding ONE low collapsed dark-green silicone cup immediately above the open mouth of a plain dark charcoal canvas bag. The bag opening, hand/arm diagonal and low cup profile must visibly determine the text space and reading route. First the carry contact and compact silhouette, then the large Korean functional sentence adjacent to that contact, then grouped specifications and release/preorder information. Use an editorial photographic composition with the Korean sentence as primary text emphasis; FOLN and Fold Cup are small restrained identifiers. The scene must show the compactness itself, with closely nested folds, rather than a tall cup merely accompanied by a hand.

Photographic scene and product:
- One unbranded dark canvas bag fills much of the lower and left side, open at its top, with a physically plausible dark interior, stitched rim and matte woven cloth. It has no labels, logos, surface text, icons or visible branded hardware. Keep the actual opening recognizable, not a featureless black slab. No extra props.
- The single cup is prominently foregrounded near this opening, outside the bag and entirely recognizable. Wide circular upper rim in perspective; no handle, no hinge; matte deep forest-green silicone body with continuous rounded horizontal accordion folds closely nested into a clearly low compact collapsed form, and a flat circular bottom. It is approximately a quarter of an expanded cup's height, but do not show a second expanded cup or any diagram. This is a fictional 350mL cup; do not print measurements on its surface.
- ONE translucent milky-white circular lid is correctly fitted all the way around this SAME cup rim. Its outer projected ellipse is exactly continuous with the cup's upper rim, the same diameter, with a coherent thin seating lip and subtle green visible through the lid. No separate, smaller, floating or tilted lid. No holes, markings or added attachments.
- A single anatomically natural human hand enters from the right with a deliberate edge crop of its forearm. It supports the cup, with thumb touching the near side below the lid, and separated fingers supporting the underside and far side. Show clear skin-to-silicone contact and distinct finger boundaries without fused materials or impossible finger counts. Keep enough of the lower folds and bottom visible to read the compressed shape. The cup is held immediately above the bag rim with a small visible gap; fingers, cup, fitted lid and cloth have consistent perspective and light. Do not make the bag hide the entire cup.
- Photograph-like close view with natural skin detail, fabric weave, matte silicone, translucent white plastic and physically consistent contact shadows. Soft directional window light gives the pale lid enough contrast against the dark cloth; preserve green body detail. Background is the same subdued deep grey photographic space, no pale seamless studio or white tabletop. Do not add glossy advertising glow, chromed surfaces, or ornamental grain.

Typography and space roles:
Make the Korean claim the main textual event, placed close to the low cup and above the real opening of the bag, in the continuous negative space shaped by the cropped forearm and bag rim. Set the entire claim as one intact line, large and clearly readable in warm white, with precise clean Hangul, a controlled comma space and natural optical spacing. Its scale must unmistakably exceed FOLN and Fold Cup. Its low horizontal line and proximity to the compact cup should connect the words to the actual carrying moment.
Place FOLN and the one-line Fold Cup together as quiet small identification in the upper-left of this same photograph, not a giant top name. Make the scene asymmetrical, allowing the forearm, compact cup and open bag rim to occupy the right/middle and cut through the page rather than sitting as an isolated centered object.
Use the bag rim and the uninterrupted dark cloth/negative area on its left to organize the remaining information: the specification belongs close to the cup/rim, while release and preorder form a tightly related pair beneath it; the URL aligns with that pair and has a deliberate larger gap. Keep a common editorial left edge through these detail groups, with visibly different gaps between their roles. They are poster typography laid over the scene, not lettering printed on the bag or product. Avoid four equal-spaced detached bottom list lines, footer panels, rules, boxes, badges or arbitrary decorative symbols. Do not make exact text unreadable on fabric folds; give it clear contrast and calm areas of the same continuous scene. All seven strings appear exactly once, entirely readable and uncropped at 720px-wide viewing size. Preserve each supplied string intact on one line, exact capitalization, spaces, dot, en dash, Korean, date and URL; do not add headings or any copy.

EXACT ENTIRE DISPLAY COPY, nothing else:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

Only the specified fictional copy appears in the poster. No real brand, real logo, product-surface lettering, fabric label, invented price/performance/certification, watermarks, fake microtype, extra captions, icons or measurements. No implied unsupported capability beyond the supplied folded-cup concept. Deliver one single edge-to-edge portrait 4:5 flat poster image.
